items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. The interviewee's response 'Oh yes' is to the interviewer's statement about hearing the interviewee's band, indicating a professional interaction as interviewer/interviewee, but no personal relationship beyond this context is described.

ctx.x: Slide was interviewed in West Orange, New Jersey on July 30, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in West Orange, New Jersey for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Slide Hampton with me today. And you know an interviewer is not supposed to tell stories, but I must tell you that a couple of years ago I heard your band at the Iridium.
